name: Solar Pinnacle deals 2 damage to target unit and Empowers 2
notes: Solar Pinnacle's element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid, then the ability's own MZCHOOSE target decision appears directly after the last reserve payment with no separate opportunity-window PASS needed. Choosing the seeded Dungeon Guide deals 2 damage to it and tags the champion EMPOWERED/EMPOWER_PLUS_2. The Fast Activation (North-facing Shifting Currents) clause is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Deal 2 damage to target unit. Empower 2.
